017package org.apache.juneau.http.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
023
024/**
025 * Default immutable implementation of {@link HttpStatusLine}.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * Create instances via the static factory methods:
029 * <p class='bjava'>
030 *    <jc>// 200 OK  HTTP/1.1</jc>
031 *    HttpStatusLine <jv>sl</jv> = HttpStatusLineBean.<jsm>of</jsm>(200, <js>"OK"</js>);
032 *
033 *    <jc>// Custom protocol version (parsed)</jc>
034 *    HttpStatusLine <jv>sl2</jv> = HttpStatusLineBean.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"HTTP/2"</js>, 200, <js>"OK"</js>);
035 *
036 *    <jc>// Custom protocol version (typed)</jc>
037 *    HttpStatusLine <jv>sl3</jv> = HttpStatusLineBean.<jsm>of</jsm>(HttpProtocolVersion.<jsf>HTTP_2_0</jsf>, 200, <js>"OK"</js>);
038 * </p>
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
042 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
043 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
044 * (and possibly earlier).
045 * For production use cases that require long-term binary stability, continue using the existing
046 * {@code juneau-rest-client} and {@code juneau-rest-common} APIs until the {@code ng} stack is declared stable.
047 *
048 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
049 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * @since 9.2.1
053 */
054public final class HttpStatusLineBean implements HttpStatusLine {
055
056   private final HttpProtocolVersion protocolVersion;
057   private final int statusCode;
058   private final String reasonPhrase;
059
060   private HttpStatusLineBean(HttpProtocolVersion protocolVersion, int statusCode, String reasonPhrase) {
061      this.protocolVersion = assertArgNotNull("protocolVersion", protocolVersion);
062      this.statusCode = statusCode;
063      this.reasonPhrase = reasonPhrase;
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Creates an {@code HTTP/1.1} status line with the given status code and reason phrase.
068    *
069    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code (e.g. {@code 200}).
070    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase (e.g. {@code "OK"}). May be <jk>null</jk>.
071    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
072    */
073   public static HttpStatusLineBean of(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase) {
074      return new HttpStatusLineBean(HttpProtocolVersion.HTTP_1_1, statusCode, reasonPhrase);
075   }
076
077   /**
078    * Creates a status line with a parsed protocol version, status code, and reason phrase.
079    *
080    * @param protocolVersion The protocol version string (e.g. {@code "HTTP/2"}). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
081    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
082    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
083    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
084    */
085   public static HttpStatusLineBean of(String protocolVersion, int statusCode, String reasonPhrase) {
086      return new HttpStatusLineBean(HttpProtocolVersion.parse(protocolVersion), statusCode, reasonPhrase);
087   }
088
089   /**
090    * Creates a status line with the given typed protocol version, status code, and reason phrase.
091    *
092    * @param protocolVersion The protocol version. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
093    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
094    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
095    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
096    */
097   public static HttpStatusLineBean of(HttpProtocolVersion protocolVersion, int statusCode, String reasonPhrase) {
098      return new HttpStatusLineBean(protocolVersion, statusCode, reasonPhrase);
099   }
100
101   @Override /* HttpStatusLine */
102   public int getStatusCode() {
103      return statusCode;
104   }
105
106   @Override /* HttpStatusLine */
107   public String getReasonPhrase() {
108      return reasonPhrase;
109   }
110
111   @Override /* HttpStatusLine */
112   public HttpProtocolVersion getProtocolVersion() {
113      return protocolVersion;
114   }
115
116   @Override /* Object */
117   public String toString() {
118      var sb = new StringBuilder(protocolVersion.toString()).append(' ').append(statusCode);
119      if (reasonPhrase != null)
120         sb.append(' ').append(reasonPhrase);
121      return sb.toString();
122   }
123
124   @Override /* Object */
125   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
126      return (obj instanceof HttpStatusLineBean o2) && eq(this, o2, (x, y) ->
127         x.statusCode == y.statusCode && eq(x.protocolVersion, y.protocolVersion) && eq(x.reasonPhrase, y.reasonPhrase));
128   }
129
130   @Override /* Object */
131   public int hashCode() {
132      return h(protocolVersion, statusCode, reasonPhrase);
133   }
134}
